name: Oak Bench Ranch
description: A real place on California's Central Coast, near Santa Ynez, used as the stage for a simulated fleet. The outline is a demo area, not a property line. The ranch name, machines, zones, plans and work log are simulated. Not affiliated with the landowner.

outline.label: Demo outline
outline.text: Demo outline drawn 2026-10-16 over oak savanna near Santa Ynez, CA. Not a parcel or property line.

nhd.label: USGS National Hydrography Dataset
nhd.text: U.S. Geological Survey, National Hydrography Dataset (NHD), flowlines named Figueroa Creek

worldcover.label: ESA WorldCover 2021
worldcover.text: © ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium

boundary.note: Demo outline drawn 2026-10-16 over oak savanna near Santa Ynez, CA (not a parcel line). 1,351 ac.

creek.name: Figueroa Creek
creek.note: USGS NHD flowlines named Figueroa Creek, clipped to the outline (public domain), simplified 4 m.

oakWoodland.note: Largest WorldCover tree cover + shrubland (classes 10, 20) patch, north-west, 142 ac.

grassland.note: Largest ESA WorldCover 2021 grassland (class 30) patch west of the creek, 416 ac (CC BY 4.0).

grasslandEast.note: Largest WorldCover grassland patch east of the creek, 462 ac.

fence.note: East, north and west edges of the demo outline (the simulated perimeter fence).

camera.targetHeightSource: Cesium World Terrain (ion asset 1), sampleTerrainMostDetailed at the target, 2026-10-16; ellipsoid height

Z-21.basis: 30 m strip inside the simulated fence on the demo outline
